reviews.review_msg: She turned arguably the most difficult class in the accounting major into something totally manageable and easy to understand. There were no surprises in the exams and her in-class practices are enough for you to do well. She's also incredibly caring and genuinely invested in students' success. I really hope she teaches undergrads again!
Prof Yang explains concepts clearly and is super kind and helpful. The textbook is only needed for the weekly assignments - no readings required. Exams were fair with no surprises.
